build_to.name: BlackHat

sockets.name: HEAD
sockets.use: the crown seat: where the top of a 57 cm head touches the inner cone. +Z up out of the crown, +X forward (the knot on the wearer's left, +Y). Attach to the head bone with SnapToTarget; tune the offset per character

build_to.frame: +Z up, +X forward, knot on +Y (wearer's left), z = 0 at the rim-tube bottom, pivot on the axis

straw.bc_is_recolour_graph: BC8 = sRGB8(Tint x (DetailBias + DetailScale x sRGBdecode(Detail8/255))) from the quantised Detail and the rounded sidecar numbers
straw.tint_is: the part's MEAN linear colour over the written texels

cloth.bc_is_recolour_graph: BC8 = sRGB8(Tint x (DetailBias + DetailScale x sRGBdecode(Detail8/255))) from the quantised Detail and the rounded sidecar numbers
cloth.tint_is: the part's MEAN linear colour over the written texels

straw.shading_model: Default Lit (or Substrate Slab); opaque; no Cloth/Fuzz layer
straw.BaseColor: saturate(Tint x (DetailBias + DetailScale x T_BlackHat_Straw_Detail.R)); at the default Tint / Bias / Scale it equals T_BlackHat_Straw_BC at every mip (source / 8-bit level)

parameters.Tint: the part's MEAN colour (linear). Set it to the colour you want the part to read as: the average of the part, and its far mips, come out at exactly that colour
parameters.DetailBias: the darkest texel as a fraction of the mean (leave at the default)
parameters.DetailScale: the detail's contrast as a multiple of the mean (leave at the default; lower it toward 0 with Bias toward 1 for a flatter, lighter recolour whose flecks do not clip)

straw.BaseColor_alt: T_BlackHat_Straw_BC (sRGB) directly, for a fixed-colour instance
straw.Detail_encoding: sRGB-encoded LINEAR detail d = (albedo - a_lo) / (a_hi - a_lo), full range 0..255, quantised once from linear float data; import sRGB ON (TC_Grayscale, G8, uncompressed)
straw.bc_equality_note: BC = the recolour graph at the defaults holds at the source (8-bit PNG) level. In Unreal BC is BC1-compressed (TC_Default) and Detail is uncompressed G8, so the two paths differ by BC1 block error
straw.Specular: 0.8 x T_BlackHat_Straw_ORM.A (the baked specular mask; linear, mip-safe)
straw.Roughness: T_BlackHat_Straw_ORM.G (with the ORM texture's Composite Texture = T_BlackHat_Straw_N, mode CTM_NormalRoughnessToGreen: Unreal widens roughness per mip by the normal map's variance)

textures.ORM: linear (sRGB OFF), TC_Masks, RGBA (A = specular mask), CompositeTexture T_BlackHat_Straw_N, CTM_NormalRoughnessToGreen
textures.all: MipGenSettings TMGS_FROM_TEXTURE_GROUP; 2048, power of two (12 mips)

cloth.shading_model: Default Lit (or Substrate Slab); opaque; no Cloth/Fuzz layer
cloth.BaseColor: saturate(Tint x (DetailBias + DetailScale x T_BlackHat_Cloth_Detail.R)); at the default Tint / Bias / Scale it equals T_BlackHat_Cloth_BC at every mip (source / 8-bit level)

parameters.Tint: the part's MEAN colour (linear). Set it to the colour you want the part to read as: the average of the part, and its far mips, come out at exactly that colour
parameters.DetailBias: the darkest texel as a fraction of the mean (leave at the default)
parameters.DetailScale: the detail's contrast as a multiple of the mean (leave at the default; lower it toward 0 with Bias toward 1 for a flatter, lighter recolour whose flecks do not clip)

cloth.BaseColor_alt: T_BlackHat_Cloth_BC (sRGB) directly, for a fixed-colour instance
cloth.Detail_encoding: sRGB-encoded LINEAR detail d = (albedo - a_lo) / (a_hi - a_lo), full range 0..255, quantised once from linear float data; import sRGB ON (TC_Grayscale, G8, uncompressed)
cloth.bc_equality_note: BC = the recolour graph at the defaults holds at the source (8-bit PNG) level. In Unreal BC is BC1-compressed (TC_Default) and Detail is uncompressed G8, so the two paths differ by BC1 block error
cloth.Specular: 0.5 x T_BlackHat_Cloth_ORM.A (the baked specular mask; linear, mip-safe)
cloth.Roughness: T_BlackHat_Cloth_ORM.G (with the ORM texture's Composite Texture = T_BlackHat_Cloth_N, mode CTM_NormalRoughnessToGreen: Unreal widens roughness per mip by the normal map's variance)

textures.ORM: linear (sRGB OFF), TC_Masks, RGBA (A = specular mask), CompositeTexture T_BlackHat_Cloth_N, CTM_NormalRoughnessToGreen
textures.all: MipGenSettings TMGS_FROM_TEXTURE_GROUP; 2048, power of two (12 mips)
